description: This file provides API utility functions for a React project, including functions for user authentication (login and signup). It manages base URL resolution with environment considerations, dynamically adjusting for preview hosts and proxies. The code also contains helper functions for URL manipulation and environment normalization.

methods.name: stripTrailingSlashes
methods.description: Removes trailing slashes from a URL string.

methods.name: ensureApiSuffix
methods.description: Ensures the URL ends with '/api' or '/api/v1'.

methods.name: isKaviaPreviewHost
methods.description: Checks if the current hostname indicates a Kavia preview environment.

methods.name: getKaviaPreviewPublicOrigin
methods.description: Returns the public origin URL of the current window location.

methods.name: looksLikeKaviaProxyUrl
methods.description: Determines if a URL appears to be a Kavia proxy URL.

methods.name: normalizeEnvBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes environment-provided base URLs, handling absolute, relative, and proxy URLs.

methods.name: resolveBaseApiUrl
methods.description: Resolves the final API base URL based on environment variables and runtime context.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password by calling the /auth/login API endpoint.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Registers a new user via the /auth/register API endpoint.
